column1: Probe the FULL operations table per boundary kind, not `id LIKE 'ad01-<cid>%'` | The design turns on whether the diagnostic path admits an operation under some other name; filtering by naming convention would hide it | probe7.py seed run: operations=0, allocations=1, attempts=1, receipts=0 | The seed/diagnostic boundary admits NO operation at all. Outcome (a) cannot be reached by re-pointing the id at an existing row

Diagnostic runs `controls.diagnostic_resolves`, which has no dsn/broker/operations reference | Confirms absence by construction, not by my filter | `grep -c 'dsn|broker|operations' experiments/ad01/controls.py` = 0 | Host-side computation; nothing routes it through the broker

Seq-0 of the model campaign HAS a real operation `ad01-<cid>-policy-s0-k0` (sandbox-exec, settled, own receipt) | If every boundary had one the repair would be a trivial re-point; the mixed picture is what makes it real | probe4/probe5: policy-s0-k0, s1-k0, s2-k0 all settled with `local:...exec-default.result` | The policy step is the operation, and it runs before the effect

Seq-1 construct+validate names `...-validate-l1-init` (in operations, settled); `executable.construction.init_operation` is the construct op | A second boundary kind with a different naming shape | probe5.py | Both are real operations; the episode carries the construct one

Seq-2 use_method names `att-<cid>-2-use` via `episode["operation_id"]` | A third kind, and the only one already surfacing its operation id | probe5.py | The episode ALREADY carries it. The defect is that nothing reads it

`att-<cid>-<seq>-dev` exists for NO seq, including constructed members | That name looked like the obvious answer; it does not materialise | probe5.py: all four False | Admitting it would be minting an id to make a row look joined. Excluded by requirement 3

The model-path s09 row is written by `policy_step.persist_step_transition` (provenance s09-m2), NOT by trajectory | trajectory's ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING never fires on that path, so editing only trajectory would be cosmetic | probe6.py: provenance=s09-m2, driver_version=ad01-policy-step-v1 | `policy_step._s09_ids` and `s09_durable_state._identity` must carry the dsn too

`effect_id` is NOT NULL but accepts the empty string | An empty-means-no-operation encoding is possible without a migration | probe6.py: empty effect_id accepted and stored | Chosen for the no-operation case: it is the only value that cannot be mistaken for an identity

`attempt_observations.content` is JSONB with no closed schema | The backward arrow needs the observation to carry the effect id | migrations/*.sql; no CHECK on content keys | `_publish_boundary` can carry `operation_id`; no migration needed

tests/test_s09m1_driver.py:169 and tests/test_s09_durable_state.py:155 assert `ad01-<cid>-b0-effect` on a DIAGNOSTIC boundary | Any honest repair breaks these; both are no-consumer campaigns where no operation exists | Read both; baseline `17 passed in 44.38s` | They pin the defect's exact value. Correcting them to assert the derived identity is a strengthening, not a weakening
